summary: Harden native batch and directory scan completeness contract

delivery.outcome: Harden fixos.diagnostics.native_scan (measure_batch, scan_dir_native, measure_tree) and quick_snapshot._measure_caches so missing paths, malformed outputs, permission errors, timeouts, and unsupported native CLIs fail closed or fall back safely without fabricated empty success.
nonGoals: Modifying or applying the retained stash in semcod/fixos-native.

architecture.decision: Validate all native JSON envelopes and per-entry/per-path completeness strictly against requested resolved paths and observed subdirectories before trusting native measurements; fall back per missing path when python_fallback=True and preserve per-path error/complete metadata into quick_snapshot.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit touching native_scan.py, quick_snapshot.py, and their unit tests.

commands: python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_native_scan.py tests/unit/test_quick_snapshot.py tests/unit/test_dashboard.py tests/unit/test_venv_cleanup.py tests/unit/test_disk_analyzer.py tests/unit/test_project_scanner.py
validation.evidence: Contract tests pass across supported binary schemas, unavailable executable, nonzero exit, malformed JSON, absent results, non-empty exclude, and permission errors.
Full unit test suite and governance checks pass.
